---
title: "Figure 1 — How the evidence is computed (CCO/COC confusion)"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
suppressMessages({library(data.table); library(ggplot2); library(patchwork)})
DIG <- "data/e743fd5"
theme_fig <- theme_classic(base_size = 8) +
    theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.32, "cm"),
          plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))
col_truth <- c(CCO = "#0072B2", COC = "#D55E00")
```

```{r panels}
## (a) protocols and example recordings ---------------------------------------
rec <- fread(file.path(DIG, "recordings.csv"))
rec[, protocol := factor(protocol, c("episodic", "stationary"),
                         c("episodic (eLife-like)", "stationary (masked equilibration)"))]
ago <- data.table(protocol = levels(rec$protocol),
                  xmin = 1, xmax = c(6, 31))          # agonist-on span, in tau
pa <- ggplot(rec, aes(time_tau, current)) +
    geom_rect(data = ago, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = Inf, ymax = -Inf),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "#0072B2", alpha = 0.08) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.25, colour = "grey25", na.rm = TRUE) +
    facet_wrap(~protocol, ncol = 1, scales = "free_x") +
    labs(x = expression("time ("*tau*")"), y = "current (pA)",
         subtitle = "shaded: agonist 10 µM; gap: masked (NaN) equilibration") +
    theme_fig
## (b) convergence dashboard of one run ---------------------------------------
tr <- fread(file.path(DIG, "trace_example.csv"))
pb <- ggplot(tr, aes(iter)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_log_Evidence_ss, ymax = mean_log_Evidence_ss_dn),
                fill = "#009E73", alpha = 0.25) +
    geom_line(aes(y = log_Evidence, colour = "trapezoid (instant)"), linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_line(aes(y = mean_log_Evidence_ss, colour = "stepping-stone up (window)"),
              linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_line(aes(y = mean_log_Evidence_ss_dn, colour = "stepping-stone down (window)"),
              linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_line(aes(y = logL, colour = "logL at beta = 1"), linewidth = 0.35) +
    scale_colour_manual(NULL, values = c("logL at beta = 1" = "grey30",
                                         "stepping-stone up (window)" = "#0072B2",
                                         "stepping-stone down (window)" = "#D55E00",
                                         "trapezoid (instant)" = "grey65")) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-372, -312)) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 1))) +
    labs(x = "iteration", y = "nats",
         subtitle = "one fit (CCO truth, episodic protocol, CCO arm)") +
    theme_fig + theme(legend.position = c(0.70, 0.28),
                      legend.background = element_blank())
## (c) confusion matrix --------------------------------------------------------
conf <- fread(file.path(DIG, "confusion.csv"))
conf[, cell := factor(paste(truth, prot),
                      c("CCO stationary", "COC stationary", "CCO episodic", "COC episodic"))]
cs <- conf[, .(m = mean(dlnZ), se = sd(dlnZ) / sqrt(.N), n = .N), by = .(cell, truth)]
pc <- ggplot(conf, aes(cell, dlnZ, colour = truth)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey50") +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 0.9, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_crossbar(data = cs, aes(y = m, ymin = m - se, ymax = m + se),
                  width = 0.4, linewidth = 0.35, fatten = 1.2) +
    geom_text(data = cs, aes(y = 10.5, label = paste0("n=", n)), size = 2.4,
              show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = col_truth, guide = "none") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = expression(Delta*"ln Z  (CCO - COC)"),
         subtitle = "evidence per recording; stationary: indistinguishable (theorem)") +
    theme_fig + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))
## (d) tempered information identity per temperature ---------------------------
## Var_beta(beta*dlogL + dlogprior) vs E_beta[beta*GFI + FIM_prior]: equals 1
## at every equilibrated rung (information equality of the tempered target)
bart <- fread(file.path(DIG, "bartlett_tempered.csv"))
bart[, ratio := as.numeric(ratio)]
pd <- ggplot(bart, aes(i_beta, ratio, colour = log10(beta + 1e-12))) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey50") +
    geom_point(size = 1.1, alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_y_log10(breaks = c(0.01, 0.1, 1, 10)) +
    scale_colour_viridis_c(name = expression(log[10]~beta)) +
    labs(x = "rung (cold to the right)",
         y = expression("Var("*beta*s[L]+s[pi]*") / E["*beta*"GFI + I"[pi]*"]"),
         subtitle = "tempered-target identity: 1 at every equilibrated rung") +
    theme_fig
fig <- (pa | pb) / (pc | pd) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a")
ggsave("Figure_1.pdf", fig, width = 7, height = 5.6, device = pdf)
fig
```

```{r table}
knitr::kable(conf[, .(pairs = .N, mean_dlnZ = round(mean(dlnZ), 2),
                      se = round(sd(dlnZ) / sqrt(.N), 2)), by = .(truth, prot)],
             caption = "Confusion matrix summary (dlnZ = lnZ_CCO - lnZ_COC)")
```
